answer: Each identity claims one tundra plot with a juniper sapling row under a 70-credit bond. Marker stakes of ivory, sealed to it, stand by the saplings, and a temperature log records freezes. An auditor measures stake heave and recomputes expected heave from the frost table for that log; shortfall, overclaim, or a moved stake burns the bond. First survey 33, k-th 33+5(k-1), 1000th 5028; 1000 fakes pay 2,530,500 plus 70,000 locked, each needing its own plot and stakes. A rented-stake ring fails: its stakes and log belong to another plot. An honest operator pays 33 once, bond returned after audit.
